name: contact-safe-form
html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head><title>Contact Us</title></head>
<body>
  <form action="/support/tickets" method="post" class="stacked dense" aria-label="Contact form">
    <label for="topic">Topic</label>
    <select id="topic" name="topic">
      <option value="billing">Billing</option>
      <option value="shipping">Shipping</option>
    </select>
    <label for="message">Message</label>
    <textarea id="message" name="message">Need help with my order.</textarea>
    <button type="submit" class="primary">Send message</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
